security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Turn any phone or tablet into a Stream Deck
bundle.longDescription: OmniPanel is a free, open-source Stream Deck alternative. Pair old phones and tablets over Wi-Fi or USB and use them as control decks: app volume, voice effects, OBS, Home Assistant, scripts, hotkeys and AI-generated actions.
